scope: Independent predictive follow-up on original-parent action traces. Use intake_01..03 (six distinct maps) for model fitting; show intake_04 and 05 four maps as independent from fitting, and the later symmetry development parental four games where the head has never run. Later development games were previously used for another policy. No tuning from these panel scores and no new native/official test games.
prediction: At every live pre-action step for trees newly planted by Sapling whose acquisition post-step is [51,250] and still held continuously, predict loss of initial ownership to an enemy within five complete joint transitions. Outputs expire at expiry or terminal. Fixed weighted logistic after training-map-weighted centering/standardization and convex Newton steps; binary target is the publicly observed own tree ownership transition. Baseline is a separate fitted model with only nearest enemy planter distance and remaining tree life. No examiner commands as labels or inputs; only public current state and three chronological past public positions.
action: Require predicted seizure probability >=0.35, at least ten further actions available, at least ten steps left in tree life, and an own collector of cargo <=25 within five moves. Choose lowest cargo then shortest path then id. Proposed initial safe shortest move must differ from natural parent's actual public move. Choose at most one tree in a game: earliest eligible time; same-step ties higher predicted risk then tree id. No retrospective selection of lost trees; include false alarms. Commit up to five steps while still owned, continue other parent/recorded opponent commands, then follow original commands five more steps. Reporting only; no automatic admission to a new original-opponent trial.
report: Across each held map, all positives and negatives, Brier/ranking/missed alarms, eligible raw count with same-step duplicate suppression, actual protected first tenures, originally safe vs endangered at +5, short-horizon official cash margin, handler's delivery/cargo and added deaths. If output fails to improve decisions or if weak support, do not promote. Do not treat overlapping roots as independent.
